ISO-FS-01.name: Read-Only Root Filesystem & Checkpoint Mount Writability Denial
ISO-FS-01.rationale: Root write probe denied read-only; checkpoint directory in subprocess fallback tier remains locally writable without container mount.

ISO-GOV-01.name: Non-Negotiable Research Governance Invariants
ISO-GOV-01.rationale: Attributable verification of authorization flags and quarantined holdout constants confirmed intact alongside policy declarations.

ISO-IPC-01.name: Safe Binary IPC Protocol (HIPC) & Adversarial Frame Rejection
ISO-IPC-01.rationale: Live inference verified over typed binary HIPC stream; corrupted magic, raw pickle, and unhandled commands failed closed.

ISO-NET-01.name: Kernel Network Namespace Isolation & Dropped Capabilities
ISO-NET-01.rationale: Subprocess fallback tier enforced HTTP/HTTPS/ALL proxy blackholing; kernel namespace isolation and raw socket denial require container/namespace tier.

ISO-REPLAY-01.name: Cryptographic Nonce Tracking & Replay Attack Denial
ISO-REPLAY-01.rationale: Replayed inference requests with duplicate nonces rejected independently on both evaluator and worker boundaries.

ISO-RES-01.name: Resource Quota & Limit Enforcement Schema
ISO-RES-01.rationale: Worker queried cgroups and rlimit interfaces successfully conforming to resource schema.

ISO-UID-01.name: Worker Identity & Privilege Escalation Restrictions
ISO-UID-01.rationale: Standard non-elevated user token verified; active escalation probe unverified on Windows host.

ISO-VAULT-01.name: Private Vault Invisibility & Symlink / Procfs Traversal Denial
ISO-VAULT-01.rationale: Direct filesystem vault isolation enforced; procfs route unsupported or partially verified on this platform.
